results.title: Pricing - ADA & WCAG Compliance Plans | ADA Scanner | ADA Scanner — Accessibility Compliance Tool
results.snippet: A Voluntary Product Accessibility Template is the document procurement teams in government, education and healthcare require before they can buy software. Ours covers the 50 WCAG 2.1 A and AA criteria, fills in what your scan proves, and asks you 17 plain questions about the rest — because a scanner cannot judge whether the keyboard order makes sense, and a report that claims it can is one you would have to defend.
